_doc: Stage 1 of the Florida-to-Bahamas map (docs/world-bimini): the open water of the Florida Straits between Miami and Bimini, 200 m cells from the NOAA ENC overview and approach cells (charts 11469 and 11013 cover the Bimini side), no DEM (the coast strips are flat land; the finer members draw the shores). Depths reach about 900 m: heights take 5 cm steps (height_unit_m). The Gulf Stream is baked over the composed world by Tools/coast/gulf_stream.py. Positions are lat/lon (NAD83).
name: FloridaStraits
display: The Florida Straits, Miami to Bimini

datum.name: MLLW (chart datum); heights in meters above it

launch: West of Bimini, on the bank edge
